title: Input Validation Policy Compiler
description: Compiles input validation rules for API endpoints. Enforces: string fields have maxLength, numeric fields have bounds, high-risk fields (SQL, HTML, URLs) have sanitization declared, no unvalidated fields, file fields have extension and size restrictions.

error_codes.IV001: input-validation-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: endpoints[], fields[] with type and constraints
error_codes.IV002: String field has no maxLength constraint — unbounded strings enable DoS and truncation attacks
error_codes.IV003: Numeric field has no min/max bounds — unbounded numbers enable overflow and business logic abuse
error_codes.IV004: High-risk field (SQL param, HTML content, URL) has no sanitization declared — specify: escape, htmlEncode, urlValidate
error_codes.IV005: Field declared in API spec but not listed in validation policy — all inputs must be explicitly validated
error_codes.IV006: File upload field has no extension allowlist or size limit — restrict to specific types and set maxBytes
